title: Mixed feelings
text:
Mixed feelings. I loved this for the first few weeks. It's heavy, sturdily built, and the wheel action and cutting are great.

Bad news: after about four or five work weeks of daily trips through the dishwasher, the cutting blade and the roller wheel are both showing slight signs of rust.

Why can't the cutting parts be made of stainless steel, just like the rest?
